name: Francesca Augostina (Faustina) Ferlaino
bioAdditions: The baptism on the tree's date, 25 February 1797, is of Francesca Angelina Ferlaino, daughter of Giuseppe Antonio Ferlaino and Rosa Gallo (S1). Her parents are new to the tree. She married Rosario Iera as 'Agostina' on 26 February 1812, aged about 15 (S2). She was buried as Faustina on 3 February 1880 (S3). The burial index gives her age as 90 and her late husband as 'Joseph'. That may be an index slip for Rosario, son of Giuseppe. The run of names (Angelina, Agostina, Faustina) needs checking on the images.

relationships.evidence: Baptism names father Giuseppe Antonio Ferlaino

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Marriage and burial indexed; baptism identification rests on the tree date plus name match (Angelina vs Agostina).

openQuestionsNew: Confirm on Book 6 image 214 that Francisca Angelina (1797) is the later Agostina/Faustina.
